      <bpmn:lane id="lane-treasurer" name="Treasurer">

        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>accept</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>link-payment</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>payment-confirmed</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>end</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="start" name="Purchase made" />

    <bpmn:task id="review" name="Review expense report" />

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="receipts-gw" name="Receipts complete and matching?" />
    <bpmn:task id="accept" name="Accept expenses for processing" />
    <bpmn:task id="link-payment" name="Link to payment system" />
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="payment-confirmed" name="Payment confirmed">
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition />
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="end" name="End" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="start" targetRef="submit" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f2" sourceRef="submit" targetRef="review" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f3" sourceRef="review" targetRef="approve-gw" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f5" name="approved" sourceRef="approve-gw" targetRef="check" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f6" sourceRef="edit" targetRef="review" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f7" sourceRef="check" targetRef="receipts-gw" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f8" name="missing or mismatch" sourceRef="receipts-gw" targetRef="edit" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f9" name="all in order" sourceRef="receipts-gw" targetRef="accept" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f10" sourceRef="accept" targetRef="link-payment" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f11" sourceRef="link-payment" targetRef="payment-confirmed" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f12" sourceRef="payment-confirmed" targetRef="end" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
